title: Naruto: Shippuden
desc: Sasuke loses his left eye to Itachi, but soon realises that it is a genjutsu created by the Mangekyo Sharingan. Shaking off the psychological trap, Sasuke launches an attack on an injured Itachi.

desc: At the peak of the fight, both Itachi and Sasuke deplete their chakra. Nonetheless, Sasuke discloses that his deeds thus far were merely a groundwork for his ultimate jutsu.
